comparator.name: Modern Greek Language and Culture (Nieuwgriekse taal en cultuur)
comparator.sourceNotes: The selected Modern Greek abroad pathway closes 60+60+60, including a 30-EC Greece/Cyprus semester, a 12-EC thesis and 30 EC of genuine free profiling. The approved home alternative is not stacked and would require a separately weighted programme. Diagnostic test and recurring tutoring are mandatory zero-credit formation. Current course evidence supports Dutch, English and Modern Greek instruction; the selected mobility path is not universalized to every permitted route.
